pool.text: Fort Brooke was established at the mouth of the Hillsborough River on Tampa Bay.
Florida officially became the 27th state of the United States of America.
Tampa was officially incorporated as the Village of Tampa by local residents.
The municipal name was officially shortened to simply Tampa by local authorities.
The Tampa Board of Trade successfully enticed Vicente Martinez Ybor to move operations.
A civic association dubbed Ye Mystic Krewe of Gasparilla staged an invasion.
The 53 mile long Tampa Electric streetcar system carried almost 24 million passengers.
Over 500 million cigars were hand rolled in Tampa during the peak year.
The institution moved into the former Tampa Bay Hotel across the Hillsborough River.
The University of South Florida was established in North Tampa by officials.
The University of South Florida was founded as a member of the State University System.
USF won an NCAA national championship for softball.
The USF Soccer Stadium hosted the men's College Cup soccer tournament finals.
The Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League were established locally.
The Learey Technical College was established to offer education in emergency and fire programs.
The NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Final Four was played at Tropicana Field.
The Buccaneers won a championship title in Super Bowl XXXVII under the NFL.
The Tampa Bay Lightning won one of their championship Stanley Cups.
Hurricane Irma made landfall near Marco Island and moved due north.
Jane Castor took office as the mayor of the city.
